learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the magic of light by understanding how it bounces, bends, and creates fascinating images through different mirrors and lenses!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Light is a speedy traveler that always moves in completely straight lines. You can easily prove this by trying to look at a candle flame through a bent tube; the light simply will not curve around the corner to reach your eye!

When light hits a smooth, shiny surface like a mirror, it bounces back like a rubber ball hitting a wall. This bouncing effect, called reflection, is exactly how you are able to see your own face in the mirror every morning.

Light plays a clever trick when it travels from one transparent material into another, like moving from air into water. It actually changes speed and bends, which is why a pencil dipped in a glass of water suddenly looks completely broken!

Lenses are curved pieces of glass that bend light on purpose. A convex lens bulges outward and can magnify tiny letters like a detective's magnifying glass, while a concave lens curves inward and makes objects look much smaller.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌈 The Hidden Colors of White Light
main_concepts.simple_explanation: White sunlight might look plain, but it is actually a beautiful mixture of seven different rainbow colors! When white light passes through a special triangular glass called a prism, it splits apart to reveal this hidden spectrum.

fun_activity.title: 🔬 The Water Coin Magic Trick
fun_activity.instructions: Place a coin at the bottom of an empty cup and step back just until you cannot see it anymore. Have a friend slowly pour water into the cup, and watch as refraction magically bends the light, bringing the coin back into view!

quick_recap: ⭐ Light travels in perfectly straight lines until it hits an object or changes its medium.
⭐ Mirrors use the power of reflection to form images, while lenses use refraction to magnify or shrink what we see.
⭐ Ordinary white light is surprisingly composed of a vibrant spectrum of seven different colors.
